descriptionEn: Pisco, fresh lime, simple syrup, egg white, Angostura. Peru's national cocktail.
descriptionZh: 皮斯科、青柠、糖浆、蛋白、安格斯图拉苦精。秘鲁国民鸡尾酒。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约16%

metaZh.label: 装饰
metaZh.value: 泡沫上滴3滴安格斯图拉苦精

ingrZh: 3滴 安格斯图拉苦精（用于泡沫）
stepsEn: Dry shake: combine pisco, lime juice, syrup and egg white in a shaker without ice. Shake hard for 15 seconds to emulsify the egg white.
Add ice and wet shake for another 12 seconds until well chilled.
Drop exactly 3 drops of Angostura bitters onto the foam. Do not stir — the pattern is part of the presentation.
stepsZh: 干摇：将皮斯科、青柠汁、糖浆和蛋白放入摇壶，不加冰用力摇15秒使蛋白乳化。
加入冰块继续摇12秒，至充分冷却。
双重过滤至冰镇碟形杯。
在泡沫上精确滴3滴安格斯图拉苦精，不要搅动——图案是呈现的一部分。
details.notesEn: The Pisco Sour is to Peru what the Negroni is to Italy — a point of national pride and endless debate. Peruvians will insist on Quebranta pisco and lime (not lemon); Chileans make their version with lemon and without egg white. I side with Peru. The three drops of Angostura on the foam are non-negotiable — they add a faint spice that ties everything together and make the drink instantly recognizable.
details.notesZh: 皮斯科酸酒之于秘鲁，正如内格罗尼之于意大利——是民族自豪感与无休止争论的交汇点。秘鲁人坚持用Quebranta皮斯科和青柠；智利人则用柠檬且不加蛋白。我站秘鲁这边。泡沫上的三滴安格斯图拉是不可妥协的——它们带来一丝若有若无的香料气息，将整杯酒串联在一起，也让这杯酒一眼可辨。
